title: Deposit BTC into PlusToken - How to transfer BTC to PlusToken? (Hungarian subtitles)
description: How to Deposit BTC into PlusToken? How to deposit BTC into the PlusToken wallet? HUN sub.

asr.full_text: All right, hi Plustoken family To do deposit for Bitcoin just open your wallet from Plustoken and go to access and click on BTC at the bottom right you will see deposit click on deposit then you will load qr code and also the address so there's a button say replicating address so basically it's copying the address you click the button you will copy the address and then you can place that address to any of your wallet that you send out For example, if you have something in your blockchain wallet You just log in to your blockchain wallet from your phone Or you can send that address to your email to put it from your computer So for example now, if I want to lower my blockchain wallet, then I just click send out on the bottom left, right, so I just hold and place the address for my plus token address and send whatever I want, I send $500 Canadian or whatever i want to send and just click container and send okay thank you for watching see you next time
